allies.rationale_text: Incentives explain whether signals are costly enough to be trustworthy or cheap enough to reward appearance over substance.
allies.source_quote: cheap symbolic signals are rewarded over costly truth-aligned behavior
allies.affinity_rationale: Canonical tension reveals core dynamic: signaling and incentive structures are deeply intertwined — 'agents rewarded for appearance-trustworthy behavior rather than be-trustworthy behavior.'
allies.activation_condition: When signal design must align with incentive structures to ensure that truthful signaling is rewarded over cheap symbolic compliance.

allies.rationale_text: Principal-agent-problem clarifies why signaling matters: the actor sending the signal may benefit from looking trustworthy even when underlying quality is weak.
allies.source_quote: appearance-trustworthy behavior rather than be-trustworthy behavior
allies.affinity_rationale: Canonical tension: 'agents optimize appearance for principals instead of underlying outcomes' — signaling is the mechanism through which PA dynamics manifest.
allies.activation_condition: When agents use signals to manage principal perception rather than demonstrating genuine competence or compliance.

allies.rationale_text: Abstraction helps signaling compress a complex reality into a legible form without forcing the receiver through every underlying detail.
allies.affinity_rationale: Canonical: 'Analogies activate pre-existing schemas, providing instant context and comprehension' — abstraction enables efficient signaling through compressed meaning.
allies.activation_condition: When complex information must be compressed into abstract signals that activate pre-existing schemas in the receiver.

allies.rationale_text: Commitment-and-consistency-bias becomes stronger when signaling turns a private view into a public identity marker, making later reversal feel reputationally costly.
allies.source_quote: publicly observable signals can bind future behavior by making reversal more expensive
allies.affinity_rationale: Medium confidence: canonical notes 'Once a verbal commitment or initial choice is signaled, psychological pressure ensures that subsequent behavior aligns with it.'
allies.activation_condition: When initial signals of commitment create consistency pressure that reinforces subsequent aligned behavior.

antagonists.rationale_text: Confirmation-bias degrades signaling when receivers filter evidence toward a preferred conclusion regardless of signal quality.
antagonists.source_quote: accurate signals to fail regardless of their quality
antagonists.affinity_rationale: Canonical: 'the audience may actively process information to reach a desired conclusion, filtering out signals that contradict their existing beliefs or political loyalties.'
antagonists.activation_condition: When receivers filter incoming signals through existing beliefs, causing accurate signals to fail regardless of their quality.

structured_tensions.tension_text: Signaling conflicts with incentives when cheap symbolic signals are rewarded over costly truth-aligned behavior.
structured_tensions.source_quote: signaling vs incentives: signaling conflicts with incentives (incentives) when cheap symbolic signals are rewarded over costly truth-aligned behavior.

structured_tensions.tension_text: Signaling conflicts with confirmation-bias when the receiver filters incoming signals toward a preferred conclusion, causing accurate signals to fail regardless of their quality.
structured_tensions.source_quote: signaling vs confirmation-bias: signaling conflicts with confirmation-bias (confirmation bias) when the receiver filters incoming signals toward a preferred conclusion, causing accurate signals to fail regardless of their quality.

curation_notes.summary: Layer 1+2 enrichment complete. incentives and principal-agent-problem at 0.90 (core signaling dynamics), abstraction at 0.80, commitment-bias at 0.70. confirmation-bias antagonist at 0.80.
donor_drops: Did not preserve donor relation widening beyond the clearly named incentive, agency, and anti-confirmation neighborhood.
open_questions: Optionality-like commitment pressure is source-real and is now partially wired through commitment-bias, but future sweeps may still sharpen the exact public-identity language.
